summary: Frontend-only test of /app/lineas SIP selector fix with Playwright-mocked GET /api/admin/lines and /api/admin/lines/options. All 5 requested checks pass: SipList shows 'Tus líneas SIP en Zadarma (4)' with 4 rows (412345 'en uso por +34919932652', others 'libre', 412348 'sin nombre'); Connect dialog SIP select lists all 4 SIPs + 'Crear…' (412345 disabled with 'en uso por +34919932652', 412346/7/8 enabled ' · libre', 'Crear una línea SIP nueva (Zadarma no deja crear más)' disabled); Reconfigure dialog preselects and enables 412345 '(la actual)'; lines-summary reads '2 números · 1 conectados · 1 libres · Líneas SIP: 4 (3 sin usar, puedes crear 0 más)'; Probar opens line-test-dialog with phone +34600850506 (call not clicked).

issues: Select triggers use bg-slate-950/60 (dark) inside a white dialog; placeholder text ('Elige la línea SIP', owner placeholder) has low contrast on the dark grey bar. Consider a light bg or lighter placeholder text.

action_items: Optional: improve contrast of Select triggers in LineDialog (bg-slate-950/60 on light dialog).
critical_code_review_comments: sipOptions(): logic correct — busy = used_by && id !== current; current SIP labelled '(la actual)' and enabled; 'new' disabled when sips_left <= 0.
seed_data_creation: None; all lines data mocked via page.route
